description: This file defines the Screencast class and related logic for handling screencast recording, frame throttling, and video recording in the Playwright core server. It manages screencast frames, video recording lifecycle, and frame throttling for tracing purposes.

classes.name: Screencast
classes.description: Manages screencast recording, frame throttling, and video lifecycle for a page.

classes.name: FrameThrottler
classes.description: Handles throttling of screencast frames to control frame rate and resource usage.

methods.name: startForTracing
methods.description: Starts screencast for tracing with throttling enabled.

methods.name: stopForTracing
methods.description: Stops screencast for tracing and disables throttling.

methods.name: throttleFrameAck
methods.description: Acknowledges a frame with throttling logic.

methods.name: temporarilyDisableThrottling
methods.description: Recharges the throttler, allowing frames to pass without throttling temporarily.

methods.name: launchAutomaticVideoRecorder
methods.description: Automatically launches a video recorder if recording is enabled in the browser context.

methods.name: _launchVideoRecorder
methods.description: Initializes a new VideoRecorder instance with specified directory and size.

methods.name: startVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts video recording with specified options.

methods.name: startExplicitVideoRecording
methods.description: Begins explicit video recording with optional size parameter.

methods.name: startScreencast
methods.description: Begins screencast with a listener and options.

methods.name: stopScreencast
methods.description: Stops screencast for a given listener.

methods.name: onScreencastFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming screencast frames and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _tick
methods.description: Internal method for managing frame acknowledgment timing based on throttling settings.
